Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to learn that your grill is not getting hot enough. Your grill should easily reach 450 F which is hot enough to sear. If your grill is not getting this hot, something is not right!

If you are using an adapter hose along with your grill, you could be inadvertently activating the built-in safety device. 

Please look for an email outreach from our Support team. We will help troubleshoot your issue and get you grilling again soon!
